def build_remediation_section(remediations: Dict[str, Any], only_text: bool
    =False, columns: int=get_terminal_size().columns, kwargs: Optional[Dict
    [str, Any]]=None) ->List[str]:
    if not kwargs:
        kwargs = {}

    separator = '+' + '=' * (columns - 2) + '+'

    if not is_using_api_key():
        vuln_count = sum(
            spec_data.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0)
            for pkg_data in remediations.values()
            for spec_data in pkg_data.values()
        )
        pkg_count = len(remediations)
        content = format_long_text(
            f'\n  {vuln_count} {"vulnerability was" if vuln_count == 1 else "vulnerabilities were"} reported in {pkg_count} {"package" if pkg_count == 1 else "packages"}. For detailed remediation & fix \n  recommendations, upgrade to a commercial license. \n',
            columns=columns,
            start_line_decorator='',
            end_line_decorator='',
        )
        result = ['   REMEDIATIONS', content, separator]
        return result

    lines = []
    for pkg_name, specs in remediations.items():
        for spec, data in specs.items():
            vulns_found = data.get('vulnerabilities_found', 0)
            version = data.get('version', '')
            recommended = data.get('recommended_version', None)
            closest = data.get('closest_secure_version', {})
            other_recommended = data.get('other_recommended_versions', [])
            more_info_url = data.get('more_info_url', '')

            closest_upper = closest.get('upper', None) if closest else None

            vuln_text = f'{"vulnerability" if vulns_found == 1 else "vulnerabilities"}'

            content = f'\n-> {pkg_name} version {version} was found, which has {vulns_found} {vuln_text}\n'

            if closest_upper:
                content += f'   The closest version with no known vulnerabilities is {closest_upper}\n'

            content += f'{" " * (columns - 2)}\n'

            if recommended:
                rec_msg = f'   We recommend updating to version {recommended} of {pkg_name}.'
                if other_recommended:
                    rec_msg += f' Other versions\n   without known vulnerabilities are: {", ".join(str(v) for v in other_recommended)}\n'
                else:
                    rec_msg += '\n'
                content += rec_msg

            content += f'{" " * (columns - 2)}\n'

            if more_info_url:
                content += f'   For more information about the {pkg_name} package and update options, visit\n'
                content += f'   {more_info_url}\n'
                content += f'   Always check for breaking changes when updating packages.\n'

            content += f'{" " * (columns - 2)}'

            lines.append(content)

    result = ['   REMEDIATIONS'] + lines + [separator]
    return result

def format_long_text(text: str, color: str='', columns: int=
    get_terminal_size().columns, start_line_decorator: str=' ',
    end_line_decorator: str=' ', max_lines: Optional[int]=None, styling:
    Optional[Dict[str, Any]]=None, indent: str='', sub_indent: str='') ->str:
    width = columns - len(start_line_decorator) - len(end_line_decorator)

    if width <= 0:
        width = columns

    wrapper = textwrap.TextWrapper(
        width=width,
        initial_indent=indent,
        subsequent_indent=sub_indent,
        break_long_words=False,
        break_on_hyphens=False,
    )

    wrapped_lines = wrapper.wrap(text)

    if not wrapped_lines:
        wrapped_lines = ['']

    if max_lines is not None and len(wrapped_lines) > max_lines:
        wrapped_lines = wrapped_lines[:max_lines]

    result_lines = []
    for line in wrapped_lines:
        if color and not styling:
            styled_line = click.style(line, fg=color)
        elif styling:
            styled_line = click.style(line, **styling)
        else:
            styled_line = line
        result_lines.append(f'{start_line_decorator}{styled_line}{end_line_decorator}')

    return '\n'.join(result_lines)

def get_printable_list_of_scanned_items(scanning_target: str) ->Tuple[List[
    Dict[str, Any]], List[str]]:
    ctx = SafetyContext()

    if scanning_target == 'environment':
        scanned_full_path = getattr(ctx, 'scanned_full_path', [])
        packages = getattr(ctx, 'packages', [])

        if not scanned_full_path and not packages:
            no_locations = 'No locations found in the environment'
            return [[{'styled': False, 'value': no_locations}]], [no_locations]

        items = []
        plain = []
        for path in scanned_full_path:
            items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {path}'}])
            plain.append(path)
        return items, plain

    elif scanning_target == 'file':
        file_obj = ctx.params.get('file', None)
        if file_obj:
            return [[{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {file_obj.name}'}]], [file_obj.name]
        return [[{'styled': False, 'value': 'No file found'}]], ['No file found']

    elif scanning_target == 'files':
        files = ctx.params.get('files', [])
        items = []
        plain = []
        for f in files:
            items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': f'-> {f.name}'}])
            plain.append(f.name)
        return items, plain

    elif scanning_target == 'stdin':
        packages = getattr(ctx, 'packages', [])
        if not packages:
            msg = 'No found packages in stdin'
            return [[{'styled': False, 'value': msg}]], [msg]
        items = []
        plain = []
        for pkg in packages:
            items.append([{'styled': False, 'value': pkg.name}])
            plain.append(pkg.name)
        return items, plain

    return [], []

                                          ctx.params.get('db', None))
    scanned_count_sentence = build_scanned_count_sentence(packages)
    now = str(datetime.now().strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'))
    timestamp = [{'style': False, 'value': 'Timestamp '}, {'style': True, 'value': now}]

    brief_info = [
        [{'style': False, 'value': 'Safety '},
         {'style': True, 'value': 'v' + get_safety_version()},
         {'style': False, 'value': ' is scanning for '},
         {'style': True, 'value': 'Vulnerabilities'},
         {'style': True, 'value': '...'}] + safety_policy_used,
        action_executed,
    ] + [nl] + [[item for item in scanned_item] for scanned_item in scanned_items] + \
        [nl] + [using_sentence] + [scanned_count_sentence] + [timestamp]

    add_warnings_if_needed(brief_info)

    return brief_info

def format_unpinned_vulnerabilities(unpinned_packages: Dict[str, List[Any]],
    columns: Optional[int]=None) ->List[str]:
    if not columns:
        columns = get_terminal_size().columns

    result = []

    for pkg_name, vulns in unpinned_packages.items():
        vuln_count = len(vulns)
        vuln_text = 'vulnerability' if vuln_count == 1 else 'vulnerabilities'
        msg = f'Warning: {vuln_count} known {vuln_text} match the {pkg_name} versions that could be'
        result.append(msg)

    return result
